description: Democratic lawmakers in both chambers of the Washington Legislature on Monday rolled out proposals to close the multi-billion-dollar hole in the state’s operating budget. While both plans include new taxes, Senate lawmakers adopted a more aggressive approach.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Noel Frame (D)
title: New taxes included in House, Senate Democrats’ plans to fix WA’s gaping budget hole — Noel Frame: Democrat for State Senate - 36th LD
